title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next, 262K context
summary: Full 262,144-token context on a 96 GB unified-memory APU. The KV cache is quantized to q4_0 with flash attention so the long context fits beside the weights, and per-layer token embeddings stay in system memory.

tested_on.label: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Strix Halo), 96 GB unified memory
tested_on.notes: GPU memory left at the firmware minimum; the driver allocates from shared memory as needed.

profile.description: Qwen3.8 Flash Next for a 96 GB Strix Halo APU. Full 262K context with a q4_0 KV cache and flash attention, with per-layer token embeddings kept in system memory. Uses almost all unified memory, so it runs on its own.
